manifest.name: dsh-roleplay
manifest.description: Role-play conversations, character-card authoring and image generation for DeepSeek Harness.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run verify-imports

bundle.text:
# dsh-roleplay bundle layer: applied over the base/web layers when this
# package is listed in a profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`.
#
# The host row `roleplay` carries both halves: the host plugin (settings,
# storage, HTTP surface) and — through this package's `dsh.client`
# declaration — the browser bundle served at /plugins/dsh-roleplay/client.js.
# Its live settings are the row's own volatile Config fields; the settings
# page writes them into the profile patch under this id.
#
# The two session modes are `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` declarations: the
# preset registry no longer scans a directory, so presets are ordinary rows.
# The session-plane plugin (`dsh-roleplay/agent`) is mounted only inside them.
# Their ids (`roleplay`, `character-forge`) are what sessions record, so they
# must stay stable for existing sessions to resume.
#
# Display text is plain strings (only built-in presets get localized labels),
# hence the bilingual names.

- insert:
    - id: roleplay
      name: 'dsh-roleplay'

    - id: preset-roleplay
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: roleplay
        name: 角色扮演 · Role-play
        description: 与角色卡进行沉浸式角色扮演对话，支持场景插图生成。 / Immersive role-play conversations with character cards, with scene illustration generation.
        order: 20
        plugins:
          # Persona, character context, illustration tool and choice-mode
          # steering. It also hides the file/web tools below from each agent
          # until the player grants them in the settings: a preset is a static
          # declaration, so the toggles cannot add or remove these rows.
          - id: roleplay-session
            name: 'dsh-roleplay/agent'
            config:
              mode: roleplay
          # Native question tool: choice mode asks the user to pick the next
          # action through the built-in ask_user_question card.
          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'
          # File permission (allowFileTools): read/write/edit + glob/grep.
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          # Web permission (allowWebTools). Search only — page fetch stays off
          # so the tool cannot be steered into exfiltrating local data to
          # arbitrary URLs.
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: false
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
          # Context compaction moved from the host plane into presets in dsh
          # 0.2; without it a long story would eventually overflow the context
          # window. Same group as the shipped standard preset.
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024

    - id: preset-character-forge
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: character-forge
        name: 角色卡创作 · Character Forge
        description: 从一句灵感生成完整角色卡：人设、开场白、世界书与头像，可导出 PNG/JSON。 / Turn one line of inspiration into a complete character card, exportable as PNG/JSON.
        order: 21
        plugins:
          # The agent interviews the user, then writes and saves complete
          # character cards through typed tools.
          - id: forge-session
            name: 'dsh-roleplay/agent'
            config:
              mode: forge
          # Native question tool, for clarifying questions with clickable options.
          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024

readme.text:
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-roleplay)

[English](https://github.com/chinosk6/dsh-roleplay/blob/main/README-EN.md) | 简体中文

- DeepSeek Harness 角色扮演插件

- 酒馆兼容角色卡生成 / 导入，支持交互式创建角色卡

- 图片生成，支持：
  - NAI 官方接口
  - ai.erp.sex 三方接口
  - Stable Diffusion WebUI 本地接口

- [dsh](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) **0.2.0-rc.2+**（仍在 dsh 0.1.x 上请安装 `dsh-roleplay@0.5.2`）
- Node **22.19+**
- [pnpm](https://pnpm.io/) **9+**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:chinosk6/dsh-roleplay
```

也可指定分支或 tag：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:chinosk6/dsh-roleplay#v0.1.0
```

Git 安装会运行 `prepare` 来构建 `lib/`。若 pnpm 提示忽略了 build script，在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml`加上：

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  dsh-roleplay: true
```

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-roleplay
```

然后重启 dsh。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-roleplay
```

- 角色卡和生成图片的缓存仍留在 `$DSH_HOME/roleplay/`，需要手动清除

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run build
```

Windows 上若 `npx` / `pnpm` 被执行策略拦住，可直接：

```powershell
node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit
node scripts/build.mjs
```

添加本地仓库到 dsh

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add -w .
```

之后重启 dsh web
- 支持导入 [RP-Hub](https://github.com/STA1N156/RP-Hub) 角色卡，部分提示词参考了此项目。
